1: Dongha moves into a shared house, unaware his mysterious roommates are hiding a vampiric secret.
Dongha’s attempts to bond spark chaos when Sunjae confesses his feelings, shaking the vampire house.
As Sunjae suspects Dongha’s blood is special, Juwon’s cold gaze hides feelings he can no longer ignore.
When Dongha’s blood awakens Juwon’s urges, passion and danger collide in one fateful night.
Juwon’s nightmares draw him closer to Dongha, while a mysterious boy dares him to follow his heart.
A seaside trip stirs buried emotions and jealousy as Juwon faces his forbidden love for a human.
Courage is a Kind of Salvation
After revealing his true nature, Juwon pulls away in fear—but Dongha’s love only grows stronger.
Reunited at last, Dongha and Juwon embrace their love and rebuild a new life among vampires.
